title: Measured Token Efficiency: Mubit vs Full Context Replay (CL-Bench)
description: Empirically measured mean input tokens per stateful run, same model (gpt-5.4), same tasks. ICL figures from the official CL-Bench artifacts (final_results/runs/icl-gpt-5.4); Mubit figures from the runs submitted in PRs #12/#14. Source: per-run usage telemetry (input/cached/output tokens, call counts).

provenance.method: mean input_tokens across 5 stateful runs per task, per system

memory_overhead_vs_own_baseline.note: Mubit stateful vs its own stateless baseline, mean input tokens per run. Negative = memory paid for itself in fewer steps.
